qualification:
Check exactly the actual std guard Drop operation, with a counter-only frame.
No SDK or guard model is stubbed. The custom harness obtains a real guard from
the original SDK and covers the same full metadata/counter/Rc/view domain.
domain: Original SDK and actual std Ref/RefMut Drop, one actual typed AccountInfo,10MiB/all view lengths, arbitrary bytes/metadata, every signed data/lamport borrow flag and nonzero usize Rc header. Method supplies live guard; contract requires its exact borrow-counter pointer and positive(shared)/-1(exclusive) live count. Only that counter may be written, exact decrement/reset checked.
remaining: Compose actual SDK acquisition postcondition and direct real-guard-model coupling before caller use. Guard types/layout, valid runtime heap embedding, complete native/owned source/child/oracle joins and successful stage1 transport remain explicit. No whole S2 or unrestricted TOTAL claim.
